commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Whoever tells another’s faults behind that person’s back will have their own told in return. From their many faults, the ones that sting will be picked out. The person who hears of the backbiting goes further, finds the faults that will hurt most, and says them to the backbiter’s face.
